newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Asian dollar deposits little changed in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Asian dollar deposits little changed in late trade.

text.p: Asian dollar deposit rates were little changed in featureless trade with most traders sidelined due mainly to an absence of fresh incentives, dealers said on Monday.

"The market was quiet and featureless in the morning on some position adjustments. Most people were sitting on the sidelines, reluctant to open or hold new positions on lack of fresh factors," a local dealer said.
"But some people are waiting for this Thursday's release of the (U.S. May) retail sales numbers, for fresh clues to market direction," he said.
In day-to-day rates, Monday/Tuesday, Tuesday/Wednesday and week-fixed were unchanged from last Fridays's common 5-5/8 5-1/2 percent, respectively.

Among longer dates, one-month was unchanged at 5-11/16 5-9/16 percent, three-months unchanged at 5-13/16 5-11/16, nine-months unchanged at 6-1/16 5-15/16 and twelve-months unchanged at 6-3/16 6-1/16 percent.
